title: three defects the method found in itself
intent: The adoption work was reviewed after the fact and three defects were found by running it rather than by reading it: the map reported a green verdict for a directory that is not a project at all; the draft proposed the first script of a package.json as the proof, which on a typical project is the dev server; and two of the eight methods of the machine surface were only named in the check, never called. All three are fixed, and the third fix is the one the method would have caught by its own rule: a check that cannot fail is a comment, and a name in a list is not a method that works.
objection: The false green was old, and the draft was new, and the unnamed methods were new too: the more surface the method gets, the more ways it can tell an agent something untrue. Fixing three of them says nothing about the fourth, and the count of defects found by running the method is itself a measure the method has never taken.
refuted_by: The count of defects found by running the method on a real project, against the count found by reading it. If running finds nothing that reading misses, the method's friction is in the wrong place and the surface should shrink instead of grow.
